title: Lanes post status where the coordinator reads them in one pass, not one Opus turn per message
why: Lane token-spend-sources (session_013NEJL2ffE4xixcyVkMbpuV), 12:16 CST Nov 8, measured: the coordinator spends about $40 an hour on Opus, and a lane message woke it for 54 of its 56 turns between 11:28 and 12:06 CST. Fix: lanes post status to their session summary or the page, and the coordinator reads them in one pass at a check-in.
